description: Surface the most-frequent topics in a profile's posts, with engagement context. Returns top N unigrams and (optionally) top N bigrams ranked by post count, each with avg_engagement, vs_baseline, and a sample_post_url. Mirrors the dashboard topics chart, server-side. Pass `scope` (a post_collections.id) to scope the analysis to a collection.

bigrams.description: Also compute and return top bigrams (default true)

scope.description: Optional post_collections.id to scope the analysis

name: get_topic_insights
title: Get Topic Insights
